title: 绿色建筑机遇
summary: 评估公司在绿色建筑领域的认证、能效解决方案与可持续材料应用。

sections.title_en: Introduction
sections.title_cn: 引言

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Opportunities in Green Building Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how MSCI Sustainability & Climate’s (MSCI S&C’s),1 outputs are determined. Opportunities in Green Building is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated based on the resource consumption and carbon intensity of their property assets, their potential exposure to environmental building regulations and their efforts to improve the environmental performance of their real estate assets.
blocks.content_cn: 本文件介绍绿色建筑机遇关键议题各组成部分的核心信息，帮助 ESG 评级使用者理解 MSCI 可持续发展与气候团队（MSCI S&C）¹ 如何形成评估结果。绿色建筑机遇属于 MSCI ESG 评级模型环境支柱下的关键议题。公司评估以其物业资产的资源消耗与碳强度、建筑环境法规带来的潜在敞口，以及改善房地产资产环境表现的措施为基础。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to the Data, ratings and scores section of “ESG Ratings Methodology.”
blocks.content_cn: 关于MSCI ESG评级模型的更多细节，请参阅《ESG评级方法论》中"数据、评级和分数"部分。

sections.title_en: Opportunities in Green Building Key Issue score
sections.title_cn: 绿色建筑机遇关键议题得分

blocks.content: The Opportunities in Green Building Key Issue score evaluates the company’s level of exposure to, and management of, opportunities on this Key Issue. The Key Issue score is based on the Exposure score and the Management score using the formula below. The Exposure score and the Management score are combined such that the Exposure score determines the weight placed on the Management score, ranging from 50% (when the Exposure score is equal to zero) to 100% (when the Exposure score is equal to 10).
blocks.content_cn: 绿色建筑机遇关键议题得分评估公司在此议题上的机遇敞口及机遇管理水平。该得分根据敞口得分与管理得分，按下列公式计算。二者的结合方式为：敞口得分决定管理得分的权重，范围从 50%（敞口得分为零）至 100%（敞口得分为 10）。

blocks.content: This score is derived from indicators that are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to best practice and 0 corresponding to lack of management. Refer to the Analyzing risk management section of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. Sources are company disclosures except where otherwise indicated.

sections.title_en: Opportunities in Green Building Practices score
sections.title_cn: 绿色建筑机遇实践得分

blocks.content: The Opportunities in Green Building Practices score evaluates the company’s ability to manage its exposure to opportunities related to the resource consumption and carbon intensity of its property assets and its efforts to improve the environmental performance of its real estate assets. This score is a component of the Opportunities in Green Building Management score and considers attributes of the company's policies and initiatives. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 绿色建筑机遇实践得分评估公司管理物业资产资源消耗与碳强度相关机遇敞口的能力，以及改善房地产资产环境表现的措施。该得分是绿色建筑机遇管理得分的组成部分，考察公司政策与举措的特征。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示相关举措有力。

sections.title_en: • Extent of green building certification commitments in portfolio or development pipeline
sections.title_cn: • 物业组合或待开发项目中绿色建筑认证承诺的覆盖程度

blocks.content: Definition: The portion of the company’s portfolio or development projects that are covered by its green building commitments. Applies to real estate companies only.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司物业组合或开发项目中，被绿色建筑承诺覆盖的比例。仅适用于房地产公司。

sections.title_en: • Extent of commercial arrangements to improve or maintain property environmental performance
sections.title_cn: • 改善或维持物业环境表现的商业安排覆盖程度

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company provides evidence of implementing commercial agreements to incentivize tenants and property managers to improve property environmental performance. Applies to real estate companies only.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否提供实施商业协议的证据，以激励租户和物业管理者改善物业环境表现。仅适用于房地产公司。

sections.title_en: • Use of green or triple-net leases
sections.title_cn: • 使用绿色租约或三重净租约

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company provides evidence of implementing green leases or triple-net leases in its tenancies. Applies to real estate companies only.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否提供在租赁关系中使用绿色租约或三重净租约的证据。仅适用于房地产公司。

sections.title_en: • Green certification commitments related to greenfield developments
sections.title_cn: • 新建项目的绿色认证承诺

blocks.content: Definition: The company’s green building strategy for greenfield sites, including whether there is a clear statement on avoiding greenfield sites, the company only develops green-certified properties on greenfield developments, or we found no evidence of green certification for greenfield developments. Applies to real estate companies only.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司针对未开发用地的绿色建筑战略，包括是否明确声明避免使用未开发用地、是否仅在此类用地上开发取得绿色认证的物业，或未发现此类开发的绿色认证证据。仅适用于房地产公司。

sections.title_en: • Evidence of flexible or mixed-use properties in portfolio
sections.title_cn: • 物业组合中灵活使用或混合用途物业的证据

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company provides evidence of flexible or mixed-use properties in its property portfolio. Applies to real estate companies only.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否提供物业组合中灵活使用或混合用途物业的证据。仅适用于房地产公司。

sections.title_en: • Evidence of urban revitalization developments
sections.title_cn: • 城市更新开发项目的证据

blocks.content: Definition: The level of urban redevelopment that the company undertakes. Best practice is urban revitalization. Applies to real estate companies only.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司开展城市再开发的水平。最佳实践是城市更新。仅适用于房地产公司。

sections.title_en: • Green building commitment extends to existing buildings in portfolio (in addition to new buildings)
sections.title_cn: • 绿色建筑承诺覆盖物业组合中的现有建筑（除新建筑之外）

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company renovates or redevelops its existing properties with either green building initiatives or green building certifications. Applies to real estate companies only.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否通过绿色建筑举措或绿色建筑认证对现有物业进行翻新或再开发。仅适用于房地产公司。

sections.title_en: Opportunities in Green Building Performance score
sections.title_cn: 绿色建筑机遇绩效得分

blocks.content: The Opportunities in Green Building Performance score evaluates the company’s performance on opportunities in green building metrics (including percentage of green-certified buildings and space, and carbon emissions ) relative to its peers. It is expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
blocks.content_cn: 绿色建筑机遇绩效得分评估公司相关指标相对于同行的表现，包括取得绿色认证的建筑和面积比例，以及碳排放。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示最高绩效水平。

blocks.content: The following provides a non-exhaustive overview of the indicators and sub-indicators used in the assessment of the Opportunities in Green Building Performance score.
blocks.content_cn: 以下为评估绿色建筑机遇绩效得分所用指标及子指标的非穷尽概览。

sections.title_en: • Green building certification score
sections.title_cn: • 绿色建筑认证得分

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the extent of certified spaces or buildings under selected green building standards. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating highest level of certification coverage across the portfolio.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估建筑或空间取得选定绿色建筑标准认证的程度。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表物业组合中最高的认证覆盖程度。

sections.title_en: ◦ Score of green certified buildings as % of total
sections.title_cn: ◦ 绿色认证建筑占建筑总量比例得分

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s performance on the share of green-certified buildings within its real estate portfolio, calculated as the percentage of total buildings that hold recognized green building certifications. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司房地产组合中绿色认证建筑的占比，按取得认可绿色建筑认证的建筑数量占全部建筑数量的百分比计算。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表最高绩效水平。

sections.title_en: ◦ Score of green certified space as % of total
sections.title_cn: ◦ 绿色认证面积占总面积比例得分

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s performance on the share of green-certified space within its real estate portfolio, calculated as the percentage of total floor area that holds recognized green building certifications. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司房地产组合中绿色认证面积的占比，按取得认可绿色建筑认证的建筑面积占总建筑面积的百分比计算。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表最高绩效水平。

sections.title_en: ◦ Evidence of green certified buildings in real estate portfolio
sections.title_cn: ◦ 房地产组合中绿色认证建筑的证据

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the extent to which the company provides verifiable evidence of green-certified buildings within its real estate portfolio, based on the availability and quality of supporting documentation such as certification records or third-party registries. Expressed as a 0–5 score, where 10 indicates comprehensive and verifiable evidence.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：根据认证记录、第三方登记名册等支持文件的可获得性和质量，评估公司就房地产组合中绿色认证建筑提供可核验证据的程度。原文表述为采用 0—5 分制，同时说明 10 分表示证据全面且可核验。（原文评分范围与分值解释不一致，待校核。）

sections.title_en: • Carbon emissions performance relative to peers
sections.title_cn: • 相对于同业的碳排放绩效

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's performance on greenhouse gas [GHG] emissions intensity (normalized by sales or by units of production), and trend in GHG emissions intensity, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司温室气体排放强度（按销售额或产量标准化）及其变化趋势相对于同行的表现。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表最高绩效水平。

sections.title_en: Opportunities in Green Building Exposure score
sections.title_cn: 绿色建筑机遇风险敞口得分

blocks.content: The Opportunities in Green Building Exposure score evaluates the company’s exposure to opportunities on this Key Issue. It is based on the Business and Geographic Exposure scores. The Geographic Exposure score functions as a multiplier on the Business Exposure score, with an impact ranging from - 50% to +50%. The Business and Geographic Exposure scores are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest opportunity and 0 corresponding to the lowest opportunity. Refer to the Analyzing risk exposure section of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. The following formula is used in the Exposure score calculation:
blocks.content_cn: 绿色建筑机遇敞口得分评估公司在此关键议题上的机遇敞口，以业务和地域敞口得分为基础。地域敞口得分作为业务敞口得分的乘数，影响范围为 -50% 至 +50%。业务与地域敞口得分均采用 0—10 分制，10 分对应最高机遇水平，0 分对应最低机遇水平。详情参见《ESG 评级方法论》的“风险敞口分析”章节。敞口得分按以下公式计算：

blocks.content:
$$
E X P _ { O G B , i } = B U S _ { O G B , i } ( 1 + 0 . 1 \big ( G E O _ { O G B , i } - 5 \big ) )
$$
Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: $E X P _ { O G B , i }$ is the Opportunities in Green Building Exposure score of company i.
blocks.content_cn: $E X P _ { O G B , i }$ 为公司 i 的绿色建筑机遇敞口得分。

sections.title_en: Business Segment Exposure score
sections.title_cn: 业务分部风险敞口得分

blocks.content: The Business Segment Exposure score of a business segment is based on a mapping of the business segment as disclosed by the company to a corresponding business activity. MSCI S&C uses the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system along with industry-specific adjustments to define business activities. The score associated with a business activity is used to calculate a Business Segment Exposure score. Each business activity score is determined by a weighted average of the Energy Use Intensity score, Energy Certification score and Water Use Intensity score of the activity.
blocks.content_cn: 业务分部敞口得分以公司披露的业务分部与相应业务活动的映射关系为基础。MSCI 可持续发展与气候团队使用标准行业分类（SIC）体系，并结合行业特定调整来界定业务活动。业务活动对应的得分用于计算业务分部敞口得分。各业务活动得分由该活动的能源使用强度得分、能源认证得分和用水强度得分的加权平均值确定。

blocks.content_cn: $E C _ { j }$ 为业务活动 j 的能源认证得分。

blocks.content: $E U I _ { j }$ is the Energy Use Intensity score for business activity j.
blocks.content_cn: $E U I _ { j }$ 为业务活动 j 的能源使用强度得分。

blocks.content: $W U I _ { j }$ is the Water Use Intensity score for business activity j.
blocks.content_cn: $W U I _ { j }$ 为业务活动 j 的用水强度得分。

blocks.content: The Energy Certification score for a given business activity is based on the proportion of total building area that is certified to the ENERGY STAR certification for buildings.
blocks.content_cn: 某项业务活动的能源认证得分，以获得建筑能源之星认证的面积占总建筑面积的比例为基础。

blocks.content: The Energy Use Intensity score is based on the aggregate energy use intensity for each business activity in thousands of British thermal units per square foot.
blocks.content_cn: 能源使用强度得分以各业务活动汇总能源使用强度为基础，单位为每平方英尺千英热单位。

blocks.content: The Water Use Intensity score is based on the volume of water used for each business activity in gallons per square foot. A score of 10 indicates the highest opportunity.
blocks.content_cn: 用水强度得分以各业务活动用水量为基础，单位为每平方英尺加仑数。10 分表示最高机遇水平。

sections.title_en: Geographic Segment Exposure scores
sections.title_cn: 地理分区敞口得分

blocks.content: Countries with strengthening energy and climate change regulations influence the adoption of green buildings. Therefore, the Geographic Segment Exposure score for a country is determined by the reduction in greenhouse gas emissions required per year to meet its publicly disclosed greenhouse gas emissions targets.
blocks.content_cn: 能源与气候变化法规不断强化的国家会影响绿色建筑的采用。因此，一国地域分部敞口得分由实现其公开披露温室气体减排目标所需的年度温室气体减排量确定。

blocks.content:
$$
G S E _ { O G B , c } = A v g ( N T A _ { c } , L T A _ { c } , G M M _ { c } )
$$
Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: $N T A _ { c } ,$ is the near-term ambition score of country or market .
blocks.content_cn: $N T A _ { c } ,$ 是国家或市场c的近期目标雄心得分。

blocks.content: $L T A _ { c }$ is the long-term ambition score of country or market .
blocks.content_cn: $L T A _ { c }$ 是国家或市场c的长期目标雄心得分。

blocks.content: $G M M _ { c }$ is the government and market mechanisms score of country or market .
blocks.content_cn: $G M M _ { c }$ 是国家或市场c的政府与市场机制得分。

blocks.content: The near-term ambition of a country is assessed by considering the annual emissions reduction rate needed to meet their publicly disclosed near-term climate targets. Countries with aggressive near-term targets have high emissions reduction rates and therefore a higher policy pressure segment score.
blocks.content_cn: 一国近期目标的雄心水平，通过实现其公开披露的近期气候目标所需年度减排率评估。近期目标更积极的国家所需减排率较高，因此政策压力分部得分也较高。

blocks.content: A country or market’s long-term ambition indicates the strength and credibility of its long-term climate targets such as net-zero commitments. Long term targets could signal the direction of future policy and regulatory developments, even in the near term.
blocks.content_cn: 国家或市场的长期目标雄心反映其长期气候目标（如净零承诺）的强度和可信度。长期目标即使在近期也可能预示未来政策和监管发展的方向。

blocks.content: The government and market mechanisms score indicates the current strength of policy and marketbased mechanisms signaling a government’s commitment to driving the energy transition.
blocks.content_cn: 政府与市场机制得分反映当前政策与市场化机制的力度，表明政府推动能源转型的决心。

blocks.content: This score is calculated as the average of carbon pricing score and fossil fuel subsidies score.
blocks.content_cn: 该得分计算为碳定价得分和化石燃料补贴得分的平均值。

blocks.content:
$$
G M M _ { c } = A v g \left( \mathit { C P M } , \mathit { F F S } \right)
$$
Where

blocks.content: Carbon Pricing Mechanisms score
blocks.content_cn: • 其中，? 是碳定价机制得分。

blocks.content: Fossil Fuel Subsidies score.
blocks.content_cn: • ? 是化石燃料补贴得分。

blocks.content: Carbon pricing mechanisms score indicates mechanisms such as carbon taxes or emissions trading systems that exert policy pressure on companies by assigning a direct cost to carbon emissions.
blocks.content_cn: 碳定价机制得分反映碳税或排放交易体系等机制，通过为碳排放设定直接成本对公司施加政策压力。

blocks.content: The fossil fuel subsidies score indicates the degree of financial support for fossil fuel consumption. Lower subsidies (higher scores) increase transition pressure by removing cost advantages, whereas high subsidies (lower scores) signal continued alignment with fossil fuel-based economic structures, thus reducing policy pressure
blocks.content_cn: 化石燃料补贴得分反映对化石燃料消费的财政支持程度。较低的补贴（较高的得分）通过消除成本优势增加转型压力，而较高的补贴（较低的得分）表明继续与基于化石燃料的经济结构保持一致，从而降低政策压力。

blocks.content: In the absence of evidence from data sources indicating that a country has near- or long-term emissions reduction targets or carbon pricing mechanisms in place, a score of 0 is assigned. In the absence of a country’s fossil fuel subsidy information, a score of 5 is assigned.
blocks.content_cn: 如果数据来源没有证据表明某国家制定了近期或长期减排目标或实施了碳定价机制，则分配0分。如果缺少某国家的化石燃料补贴信息，则分配5分。
